title: Generative AI
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), covering the principles, applications, and ethical considerations of generative models such as GPT, GANs, VAEs, and diffusion models. Participants will explore how these models work, their real-world applications, and how to build and fine-tune them using Python frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers.

By the end of the training, participants will gain hands-on experience in building AI-generated content, including text, images, and audio, while understanding the risks and mitigation strategies associated with generative AI.
audience: AI & ML Enthusiasts looking to understand and implement generative AI models.
Data Scientists & ML Engineers aiming to enhance their knowledge in deep learning and generative models.
Software Developers interested in integrating generative AI capabilities into applications.
Researchers & Academicians exploring advancements in AI-driven creativity.
Business & Product Leaders seeking to understand generative AI for strategic decision-making.
methodology: The training follows a practical, hands-on approach with a blend of:
Lectures & Concept Explanations – Covering theoretical foundations with real-world
examples Live Coding Demonstrations – Step-by-step implementation of generative AI models.
Hands-on Labs & Exercises – Practice coding assignments and projects.
Case Studies & Industry Applications – Analysis of how generative AI is used in various domains.
Group Discussions & Q&A – Encouraging knowledge sharing and problem-solving.
Capstone Project – A final project where participants build and deploy a generative AI model.
competencies: By completing this course, participants will develop competencies in:
Understanding Generative AI Architectures (e.g., GANs, VAEs, Transformers).
Building & Fine-Tuning Generative Models using AI frameworks.
Generating AI-driven Content such as text, images, and audio.
Applying Generative AI in Business & Creative Fields.
Addressing Ethical, Bias, & Security Challenges in AI.
objectivesIntro: Upon successful completion, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the core concepts of Generative AI and its different architectures.
Implement Deep Learning Models for content generation.
Use Python & AI Frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) for generative tasks.
Apply Text Generation, Image Synthesis, and Audio Generation techniques.
Identify and mitigate bias, hallucinations, and security risks in generative AI.
Deploy generative AI solutions in real-world applications.

Understanding BERT, GPT, and Other LLMs
